errors.wrongRecoveryPassphrase: That recovery passphrase doesn't match this account.
errors.decryptFailedBookmarks: Could not decrypt remote bookmarks. Your local data key may be out of date - try unlocking again.
errors.decryptFailedHistory: Could not decrypt remote history. Your local data key may be out of date - try unlocking again.
errors.syncConflict: Could not save bookmarks - another device synced at the same moment. Try syncing again.
errors.partialSyncFailure: Synced, but {{count}} bookmark(s) could not be applied (often a temporary Chrome bookmark rate limit) - try syncing again in a minute.
errors.decryptFailedPasswords: Could not decrypt your saved passwords - try unlocking again from the popup.
errors.passwordsServerOutdated: This server doesn't support saved passwords yet - update your BrowserSync server to sync them.
errors.passwordsSyncConflict: Other devices kept changing your passwords during this sync - it will retry later.

common.notConnected: Not connected. Open the BrowserSync toolbar icon to log in first.

connectForm.switchToLogin: Already have an account? Log in
connectForm.testStatusCouldNotConnect: Could not connect to that server. Check the URL and try again.
connectForm.healthNotBrowserSync: That server responded, but it isn't a BrowserSync server. Check the URL.
connectForm.healthServerOutdated: That BrowserSync server is too old for this extension. Ask its admin to update it.
connectForm.healthServerOutdatedVersion: That BrowserSync server (v{{version}}) is too old for this extension. Ask its admin to update it.
connectForm.healthExtensionOutdated: This extension is too old for that server. Update BrowserSync and try again.
connectForm.healthUnhealthy: The BrowserSync server is up but reports a problem (e.g. its database is down). Try again later or contact its admin.
connectForm.savedConfirmLabel: I've saved this passphrase somewhere safe
connectForm.confirmCantBeUndone: Click again to confirm - can't be undone
connectForm.errEmailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try logging in instead.
connectForm.errInvalidCredentials: Email, password, or recovery passphrase is incorrect.
connectForm.errRegistrationDisabled: This server isn't accepting new accounts right now. Ask your admin.
connectForm.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
connectForm.errNetworkServer: Could not reach that server. Check the URL and your connection.
connectForm.errPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
connectForm.errNewPasswordTooShort: New password must be at least 8 characters.

popup.unlockPromptPrefix: Enter your password to resume syncing
popup.repairPrompt: This device needs to be reconnected. Enter your password and recovery passphrase.
popup.deviceNeedsRepair: This device needs setting up again
popup.restoreBookmarksHint: Replaces this device's bookmarks with whatever's currently synced on the server. Use this if this device's bookmarks ever end up wrong or out of sync.
popup.confirmForceRestore: Click again to confirm - local bookmarks will be lost
popup.pushBookmarksSummary: Push this device's bookmarks to the server
popup.pushBookmarksHint: The reverse of restoring: discards whatever's currently synced and replaces it with this device's bookmarks instead. Use this if the server ended up with the wrong bookmarks and this device has the ones you actually want.
popup.pushedStatus: This device's bookmarks are now what's synced.
popup.confirmForcePush: Click again to confirm - synced bookmarks will be lost
popup.deleteAccountSummary: Delete account and all synced data
popup.deleteAccountHint: This permanently deletes your account and every synced blob from the server. It cannot be undone.
popup.serverRequiredHint: No official hosted server is available yet - enter your own server's URL and test the connection.
popup.savePassphraseHint: The only way to set up other devices or reset your password. Save it in a password manager - if lost, nobody can recover your data.
popup.deviceSetupHint: Enter your recovery passphrase once - after this, your password alone unlocks BrowserSync here.
popup.firstSyncChoiceHint: Keep them and merge with what's already synced (bookmarks on both sides may end up duplicated), replace this device's bookmarks with the synced ones, or discard what's synced and use this device's bookmarks instead.
popup.enterBothCredentials: Enter both your password and recovery passphrase.
popup.firstSyncChoicePending: This device has bookmarks that were never synced with this account. Open Settings and use "Restore bookmarks from server", or log out and back in, to resolve this.

onboarding.subtitle: Sync your bookmarks across devices, end-to-end encrypted.
onboarding.footerNotePrefix: By creating an account you agree to how this service handles your data - see
onboarding.footerNoteSuffix: (ask whoever gave you the server URL if this link doesn't open).
onboarding.serverRequiredHint: BrowserSync needs a self-hosted server - there's no official hosted one (yet). Enter the URL of the server you or your team is running below, and test the connection before continuing.
onboarding.savePassphraseHint: This is the only way to set up additional devices or reset your password if you forget it. Save it in a password manager (Bitwarden, 1Password, KeePass, etc.) right now - if you lose it, nobody, not even the server admin, can recover your synced data.
onboarding.deviceSetupHint: This is a new device for this account. Enter your recovery passphrase once to finish connecting it - after this, your password alone will unlock BrowserSync here.
onboarding.firstSyncChoiceHint: Keep them and merge with what's already synced (bookmarks that exist on both sides may end up duplicated), start fresh and replace this device's bookmarks with the synced ones, or discard what's synced and use this device's bookmarks instead.
onboarding.resetPasswordHint: Enter your recovery passphrase to prove it's you, and choose a new password.
onboarding.inPageHint: Adds a key icon to password fields and offers to save new logins. Chrome will ask for permission to access websites.

viewer.lockedPrompt: Enter your password to view your synced data.
viewer.needsRepairHint: This device needs to be reconnected before it can show your synced data. Open the BrowserSync toolbar icon - it will walk you through reconnecting with your password and recovery passphrase.
viewer.extensionsHint: This reflects whichever device synced most recently - extension lists aren't merged across devices, each sync simply uploads that device's current list.
viewer.noBookmarksSynced: No bookmarks have been synced yet.
viewer.noExtensionsSynced: No extension list has been synced yet.
viewer.decryptErrorPrefix: Could not decrypt your synced data - this usually means the passphrase is wrong.

devices.devicesHint: Every device currently signed into this account. Revoking a device signs it out - it won't be able to sync again until someone logs back in on it. A "never used" badge usually means a leftover from reinstalling the extension rather than a device someone's actually using.
devices.networkError: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
devices.confirmRevokeOthers: Revoke every device except this one? Each one will need to log in again to sync.
devices.confirmRevokeThisDevice: This is the device you're using right now. Revoking it signs it out too. Continue?
devices.confirmRevokeDeviceNamed: Sign out "{{label}}"? It will need to log in again to sync.

passwords.lockedPrompt: Enter your password to open your saved passwords.
passwords.needsRepairHint: This device needs to be reconnected before it can open your passwords. Open the BrowserSync toolbar icon - it will walk you through reconnecting with your password and recovery passphrase.
passwords.lockedError: BrowserSync is locked. Unlock it to continue.
passwords.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
passwords.empty: No saved passwords yet. Add one or import a CSV exported from your browser.
passwords.confirmDelete: Delete the password for {{username}} on {{site}}? This also deletes it on your other devices.
passwords.siteAndPasswordRequired: Enter at least a site and a password.
passwords.syncedCount: {{count}} saved - encrypted end to end, the server can't read them.
passwords.importUnrecognized: Couldn't recognize that file. Export your passwords as CSV from chrome://password-manager/settings and try again.
passwords.importDone: Imported {{added}} passwords ({{skipped}} skipped as duplicates or empty). The CSV file is NOT encrypted - delete it now.
passwords.inPageTitle: Suggest and save passwords on websites
passwords.inPageOffHint: Off. When on, a key icon appears in password fields with your saved accounts for that site, and BrowserSync offers to save new logins. Requires permission to access websites.
passwords.inPageOnHint: On. Click the key icon in a password field to pick a saved account. Nothing is filled without your click.
passwords.inPageEnabledNotice: Turned on. Reload any tabs that were already open for it to work there. You may want to turn off the browser's own "Offer to save passwords" so you don't get two prompts.
passwords.matchDomainHint: Offered on the site and all its subdomains: example.com also matches login.example.com.
passwords.matchHostHint: Offered only on the exact same host and port: login.example.com doesn't match example.com.
passwords.matchStartsWithHint: Offered when the page URL starts with the saved URL, e.g. https://example.com/app/.
passwords.matchExactHint: Offered only when the page URL is exactly the saved URL.
passwords.confirmDisableInPage: Turn off password suggestions and save prompts on websites? Your saved passwords are kept.
passwords.exportWarning: The CSV file is NOT encrypted: anyone who opens it can read every password. Import it where you need it and delete it right after. For a safe copy, use the encrypted full backup in Settings instead.
passwords.exportDone: Exported {{count}} passwords. Delete the CSV file once you've imported it.
passwords.backupHint: Export or restore an encrypted file with your passwords, bookmarks and settings.
passwords.neverHint: Sites where you chose "Never" in the save prompt. Saved passwords are still suggested there.
passwords.totpHint: Optional. Paste the key or otpauth:// link the site gives you when you turn on two-step verification. Handy, but whoever opens your vault would then have both factors.
passwords.totpInvalidInput: That two-step verification key isn't valid. Paste the key (letters A-Z and digits 2-7) or the full otpauth:// link.

inPage.locked: BrowserSync is locked. Unlock it to see your saved passwords.
inPage.saveFailed: Could not save. Is BrowserSync unlocked?
inPage.neverForHost: Never offer to save passwords on {{host}}

backup.lockedPrompt: Enter your password to export or restore a backup.
backup.exportHint: Downloads one file with what you pick below, encrypted with a backup password you choose. Keep that password safe: without it, nobody can open the file - not even you.
backup.accountPasswordHint: Asked every time, so an unlocked browser alone isn't enough to take your data.
backup.exported: Backup downloaded. Store it somewhere safe, separately from its password.
backup.restoreHint: Adds what's in a backup file to this account: passwords are merged (exact duplicates are skipped), bookmarks go into a new folder under "Other bookmarks", and settings replace this device's.
backup.backupPasswordTooShort: The backup password needs at least {{min}} characters.
backup.notABackup: That file isn't a BrowserSync backup.
backup.newerFormat: This backup was made by a newer version of BrowserSync. Update the extension to open it.
backup.restoredBookmarks: Bookmarks: {{count}} restored into a new folder in "Other bookmarks".

settings.passwordsHint: Your vault, in-page suggestions and URL matching.
settings.devicesHint: See and sign out the devices using this account.
settings.logoutHint: Signs this device out. Your synced data stays on the server.
settings.confirmLogout: Log out of BrowserSync on this device?
settings.confirmLogoutPending: Some password changes haven't synced yet and will be lost if you log out now. Log out anyway?
settings.confirmDeleteAccount: Permanently delete your account and all synced data? This cannot be undone.
settings.confirmForceRestore: Replace this device's bookmarks with the synced ones? This device's current bookmarks will be lost.
settings.confirmForcePush: Replace the synced bookmarks with this device's? The bookmarks currently synced will be lost on every device.
